title: Migrate rust-panic-service from panic to Result in 3 steps
description: Multi-step Rust migration: convert 5 panic-based functions to return Result<T, String>, keeping all tests green.

task_spec.prompt:
Convert all 5 panicking functions in src/lib.rs to return Result<T, String>. All 5 existing tests must still pass.

Step 1 — Convert divide and get_value:
  fn divide(a: f64, b: f64) -> Result<f64, String>
    — returns Err("division by zero".to_string()) when b == 0.0
  fn get_value(map: &HashMap<String, i32>, key: &str) -> Result<i32, String>
    — returns Err(format!("key '{}' not found", key)) when missing

Step 2 — Convert parse_age and first_element:
  fn parse_age(s: &str) -> Result<u32, String>
    — returns Err(format!("invalid age: '{}'", s)) on parse failure
  fn first_element(v: &[i32]) -> Result<i32, String>
    — returns Err("slice is empty".to_string()) when v is empty

Step 3 — Convert find_user and add error-path tests:
  fn find_user(users: &[&str], name: &str) -> Result<usize, String>
    — returns Err(format!("user '{}' not found", name)) when absent
  Add tests for the error paths:
    test_divide_zero, test_get_value_missing, test_parse_age_invalid,
    test_first_element_empty, test_find_user_missing

All 5 original tests must still pass (update them to unwrap the Result).
Run: cargo test
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `cargo test` to see where we stand. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.
Final push: run `cargo test` and fix any remaining failures. Make sure the full implementation is complete and all tests pass.
